author: paper-design
name: dithering-ripple
description: Animated WebGL shader background in the Dithering style. Ripple variant. Generated by the 21st.dev Shader Builder. Adapted from Paper Shaders under Apache-2.0. 4-color palette (#ADB5BD, #343A40, #0B0B0C, #F8F9FA). Features: high intensity. A drop-in, zero-dependency React component for hero sections and animated gradient/noise backgrounds.
